---
title: Upgrade sample contracts to soroban-sdk 29
labels: complexity: high, area: contracts
---

The samples use soroban-sdk 25.3.2. From version 26 the SDK must be built with `stellar contract build` (stellar-cli 25.2+), not plain `cargo`.

## Task

Upgrade to the latest soroban-sdk 29.x, switch `scripts/build-contracts.ts` to `stellar contract build`, install stellar-cli in CI, fix any API changes, rebuild `contracts/artifacts`, regenerate the spec fixtures, redeploy to testnet and re-record the example scenarios and RPC fixtures.

## Acceptance criteria

- `cargo test`, clippy and all JS test suites pass.
- `docs/deploying-samples.md` reflects the new build steps.
- CI builds the WASM and checks it matches the committed artifacts.
